description: NaLaTa₂O₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4m2 space group. Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form a mixture of corner and face-sharing LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. There are eight shorter (2.69 Å) and four longer (2.78 Å) La-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ta atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent La and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent La and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent La and two equivalent Ta atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLa₄Ta₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
